A '''Worrt Casserole''' was a type of food made from [[Worrt/Legends|worrt]] meat. During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Bren Kingal]] gave a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a Worrt [[Casserole/Legends|Casserole]].

The recipe was: "[[Salt/Legends|Salt]] 1 small worrt; dust with mounder [[Flour/Legends|flour]]. Saute in [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]] until brown; place in casserole dish, pour pan dripping over worrt. Add 1 handful (humanoid hand) [[trimpian]], 1 pinch [[Tomo-spice|tomo spice]]. Fill casserole with blue milk, cover, bake at medium heat until tender. Serves 1."

==Behind the scenes==
Worrt Casserole appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
